title: Audio Solutions
description: Clear, powerful sound for audiences of every size. We deploy DAS Aero line arrays, JBL SRX speakers and stage monitors, wired and wireless in-ear systems and a Waves LV1 digital console — set up, tuned and mixed by experienced engineers for concerts, conferences and celebrations alike.

title: Display Solutions
description: High-impact visuals that hold every eye in the room. From ABSEN LED walls to digital standees and podiums, driven by Resolume media servers and precise projection mapping, we bring presentations, live feeds and brand content to life on any stage or venue.

title: Lighting Solutions
description: Lighting that sets the mood and frames every moment. Our stage and event lighting, intelligent moving heads, timecode-synchronised shows and laser systems are designed and programmed to your event, turning any space into a stage with precise, repeatable cues.

title: Truss & Rigging Systems
description: Safe, solid structures for stages, lighting, screens and sound. Our aluminum truss, ground support and roof systems are planned around the load they carry and installed by a trained rigging crew, from the first piece of setup to the final dismantle.

title: Technical Consultation & Event Planning
description: Expert technical guidance from the first site visit to show day. We assess your venue, design the audio-visual system, prepare technical drawings and layouts, and coordinate production, so every element of your event is planned, compatible and delivered on schedule.
